items.markdown:
A Casing Collar Locator (CCL) is `a downhole wireline tool used to accurately measure depth in a cased well by detecting the magnetic anomalies created by the increased metal mass of casing collars (joints)` . It provides crucial depth correlation for operations like perforation, ensuring precise placement by creating a "collar log" of the well.[[1]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/c/casing_collar_locator_ccl)[[2]](https://huntingplc.com/products-services/perforating-logging-systems/logging-and-perforating-instruments/casing-collar-locator-ccl/#:~:text=A%20Casing%20Collar%20Locator%20%28CCL%29%20is%20a,installed%20at%20the%20upper%20and%20lower%20ends)[[3]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DHyQXkvoDmd/)[[4]](https://www.weatherford.com/drilling-and-evaluation/wireline-products/perforating-systems/shooting-casing-collar-locator-%E2%80%93-aes/)[[5]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/what-is-casing-collar-locator-ccl/)

**Key Aspects of CCL Technology:** 

- **Operating Principle:** The tool uses permanent magnets and a coil to create a magnetic field. When the tool passes a collar (where two pipes connect), the increased metal volume disrupts the magnetic flux, inducing a voltage in the coil that is recorded as a "kick" or spike on the log.
- **Purpose:** It is primarily used for depth control in cased-hole logging, correlating the current operation to a reference log (e.g., Gamma Ray) to locate specific zones for perforating, packers, or bridge plugs.
- **Components:** A typical CCL consists of permanent magnets (often rare-earth magnets) and a coil, sometimes combined with a diode pack for "shooting" (perforating) operations.
- **Types:** Passive CCLs require no power to detect the metal, while active systems may be used in specialized applications.[[1]](https://glossary.slb.com/terms/c/casing_collar_locator_ccl)[[2]](https://www.welltec.com/products-services/intervention/casing-collar-locator-ccl#:~:text=Casing%20Collar%20Locators%20%28CCLs%29%20provide%20a%20rugged%2C,casing%20collars%2C%20hardware%20and%20even%20perforations%20downhole.)[[3]](https://onepetro.org/SPEADIP/proceedings-pdf/25ADIP/25ADIP/D031S091R006/5285146/spe-229500-ms.pdf)[[4]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/what-is-casing-collar-locator-ccl/)[[5]](https://huntingplc.com/products-services/perforating-logging-systems/logging-and-perforating-instruments/casing-collar-locator-ccl/#:~:text=A%20Casing%20Collar%20Locator%20%28CCL%29%20is%20a,installed%20at%20the%20upper%20and%20lower%20ends)[[6]](https://www.weatherford.com/drilling-and-evaluation/wireline-products/perforating-systems/shooting-casing-collar-locator-%E2%80%93-aes/)[[7]](https://www.corelab.com/products/casing-collar-locator/#:~:text=Casing%20Collar%20Locator.%20Owens%20shooting%20Casing%20Collar,various%20cased%20hole%20tools%20such%20as%20Gamma)[[8]](http://www.lsea.com.sg/oilandgas/cased-hole-perforatingcoring-depth-logging-tool/rugged-ccl-tool/)

**Key Features and Benefits:** 

- **High Precision:** Offers superior depth correlation to ensure tools are placed at the exact intended depth.
- **Rugged Design:** Built to withstand harsh downhole environments, including high temperatures and pressures.
- **Compatibility:** Widely used in combination with other tools, such as perforating guns, to ensure precise, simultaneous depth control.[[1]](https://huntingplc.com/products-services/perforating-logging-systems/logging-and-perforating-instruments/perforating-casing-collar-locator-ccl/#:~:text=Product%20summary.%20Renowned%20for%20repeatedly%20withstanding%20the,log%2C%20such%20as%20a%20gamma%20ray%20%28GR%29/CCL.)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DHyQXkvoDmd/)[[3]](https://www.weatherford.com/drilling-and-evaluation/wireline-products/perforating-systems/shooting-casing-collar-locator-%E2%80%93-aes/)[[4]](https://www.welltec.com/products-services/intervention/casing-collar-locator-ccl#:~:text=Casing%20Collar%20Locators%20%28CCLs%29%20provide%20a%20rugged%2C,casing%20collars%2C%20hardware%20and%20even%20perforations%20downhole.)[[5]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/what-is-casing-collar-locator-ccl/)

**Common Applications:** 

- **Depth Control:** Ensuring accurate placement of tools during logging, perforating, or workover operations.
- **Perforation Operations:** Locating specific collars to position perforating guns accurately.
- **Well Maintenance:** Detecting casing failures or identifying the position of specific, marked casing joints.[[1]](https://www.weatherford.com/drilling-and-evaluation/wireline-products/perforating-systems/shooting-casing-collar-locator-%E2%80%93-aes/)[[2]](https://www.vigoroiltools.com/news/what-is-casing-collar-locator-ccl/)[[3]](https://www.cnps.com/casing-collar-locators-how-they-enhance-well-integrity/#:~:text=The%20Role%20of%20Casing%20Collar%20Locators%20in,wellbore%2C%20which%20is%20critical%20for%20several%20reasons.)[[4]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DHyQXkvoDmd/)
